data.name: Devices.DemoBanner

data.name: Devices.Empty.Body
data.value: Add your first device to switch it from here.

data.value: The device may be working fine. These are the usual reasons:

data.name: Offline.OtherNetwork.Title
data.value: Your phone is on a different network

data.name: Offline.OtherNetwork.Body
data.value: Join the same Wi-Fi as the device. A guest network or mobile data won't work.

data.name: Offline.Isolation.Body
data.value: Some routers stop wireless devices from seeing each other ("AP isolation" or "client isolation"). Turn it off for your home network.

data.name: Offline.Power.Title
data.value: The device is off or out of range

data.name: Offline.Power.Body
data.value: Check that it has power. If your Wi-Fi changed, set the device up again.

data.name: Device.NotFound.Body
data.value: It may have been removed from this phone.

data.name: Device.Offline.Body
data.value: Showing the last known state. Switches work again when the device is found.

data.name: Device.Unauthorized.Title
data.value: This phone is no longer allowed to control it

data.name: Device.Unauthorized.Body
data.value: The device was reset or set up with another phone. Forget it here, then add it again.

data.name: Device.Restart.Done
data.value: Restarting. It will be back in a few seconds.

data.name: Device.Forget.Body
data.value: {0} stays connected to your Wi-Fi, but this phone won't control it any more. To use it again, factory reset it and add it again.

data.name: Device.Reset.Body
data.value: {0} will forget its Wi-Fi and this phone, switch everything off and wait to be set up again.

data.name: Device.Reset.Done
data.value: Device reset. You can set it up again from Add.

data.name: Action.Unreachable
data.value: The device didn't answer. Check that it's powered and on this network.

data.name: Action.Unauthorized
data.value: This phone is no longer allowed to control the device.

data.name: Action.Failed
data.value: Something went wrong. Please try again.

data.name: Notice.SwitchFailed
data.value: Couldn't switch {0}. The change was undone.

data.name: Notice.NotOnLocalNetwork
data.value: Connect to Wi-Fi to reach your devices.

data.name: Settings.Language.RtlPreview.Body
data.value: For checking layouts in right-to-left languages.

data.name: Settings.Demo.Body
data.value: Try the app with simulated devices, no hardware needed.

data.name: Settings.Privacy
data.value: Your Wi-Fi password is sent only to the device, over an encrypted Bluetooth link, and is never stored on this phone.

data.name: Wizard.CloseConfirm.Body
data.value: The device is joining your Wi-Fi. If you leave now, you may need to set it up again.

data.name: Blocked.BluetoothOff.Body
data.value: Bluetooth is used only to find a new device and give it your Wi-Fi details.

data.name: Blocked.BluetoothUnsupported.Body
data.value: This phone or computer has no Bluetooth LE, so it can't set up new devices. You can still control devices that are already set up.

data.name: Blocked.PermissionDenied.Body
data.value: To find your new device, the app needs permission to scan for nearby Bluetooth devices.

data.name: Blocked.PermissionDeniedPermanently.Body
data.value: Nearby-device access is turned off for this app. Turn it on in Settings, then come back.

data.name: Find.Demo
data.value: Demo mode: these devices are simulated.

data.name: Find.Help.Power
data.value: Plug it in. Its light blinks twice in a row when it's ready.

data.name: Find.Help.Reset
data.value: Already set up with another phone? Hold its button for 5 seconds to reset it.

data.name: Find.Help.Close
data.value: Keep your phone within a few metres of it.

data.name: Find.Help.Location
data.value: On this Android version, Location must be on to find Bluetooth devices.

data.name: Connecting.Pairing.Body
data.value: If your phone asks to pair, tap Pair. This keeps your Wi-Fi password private.

data.name: Network.Recovery.Body
data.value: It couldn't reach its Wi-Fi. Enter the new network details to reconnect it.

data.name: Network.Band
data.value: Your device needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. 5 GHz-only networks won't work.

data.name: Network.ScanFailed
data.value: Couldn't list networks. Scan again, or type the name below.

data.name: Network.NoneSeen
data.value: No networks found. Scan again, or type the name below.

data.name: Network.Ssid.Placeholder
data.value: Exactly as it appears on your router

data.name: Network.Password.Hint
data.value: Leave empty for an open network.

data.name: Network.DemoHint
data.value: Demo: the password for {0} is {1}. Try a wrong one too.

data.name: Credential.SsidTooLong
data.value: That network name is too long (32 bytes at most).

data.name: Credential.PasswordTooShort
data.value: Wi-Fi passwords have at least 8 characters.

data.name: Credential.PasswordTooLong
data.value: Wi-Fi passwords have at most 63 characters.

data.name: Credential.PasswordInvalidCharacters
data.value: Use only letters, numbers, spaces and standard symbols.

data.name: Progress.Body
data.value: Keep the app open. This usually takes under 30 seconds.

data.name: Progress.Joining.Body
data.value: The device is signing in to your network.

data.name: Progress.Finding.Body
data.value: The device restarts and comes online.

data.name: Naming.Body
data.value: Give it a name you'll recognise.

data.name: Failure.ConnectFailed.Advice
data.value: Move closer, make sure it's powered, and try again.

data.name: Failure.PairingFailed.Advice
data.value: Tap Pair when your phone asks. If it keeps failing, remove the device from your phone's Bluetooth settings and try again.

data.name: Failure.UnsupportedDevice.Title
data.value: This device needs a newer app

data.name: Failure.UnsupportedDevice.Advice
data.value: Update IoT Starter, then try again.

data.name: Failure.DeviceDisconnected.Advice
data.value: Stay close to the device and try again. What you typed is kept.

data.name: Failure.WrongPassword.Advice
data.value: Check upper and lower case and try again.

data.name: Failure.NetworkNotFound.Advice
data.value: Move the device closer to the router. The network must be 2.4 GHz, and the name must match exactly.

data.name: Failure.NoIpAddress.Title
data.value: The router didn't give it an address

data.name: Failure.NoIpAddress.Advice
data.value: Restart the router, or check that it isn't blocking new devices (MAC filtering or a full address pool).

data.name: Failure.WifiTimeout.Title
data.value: The network didn't answer in time

data.name: Failure.WifiTimeout.Advice
data.value: Move closer to the router and try again.

data.name: Failure.UnsupportedSecurity.Advice
data.value: Use a home network with a password (WPA2) or an open network. Company (Enterprise) networks aren't supported.

data.name: Failure.NotAuthorized.Title
data.value: This device belongs to another phone

data.name: Failure.NotAuthorized.Advice
data.value: Set it up from the phone it belongs to, or factory reset it by holding its button for 5 seconds.

data.name: Failure.NotOwner.Title
data.value: This device is set up with another phone

data.name: Failure.NotOwner.Advice
data.value: Factory reset it by holding its button for 5 seconds, then add it again.

data.name: Failure.DeviceError.Advice
data.value: Try again. If it keeps happening, restart the device.

data.name: Failure.Unreachable.Title
data.value: Connected, but your phone can't reach it

data.name: Failure.Unreachable.Advice
data.value: The device joined your Wi-Fi. These are the usual reasons your phone can't see it:
